note: Phrases a hint uses to send the learner to something its item must have. `picture`: the hint tells the learner to look at an image, so the item shows one (a hint that only mentions photos as a topic is not matched). `both`: the hint speaks of exactly two things, so the item offers no more than two choices (a plain 'two' is not matched). Spaced scripts match whole words; CJK matches the text. Used by the gate item.hint-fits; each list is proven on the first jury run's drafts.
